sourceStatement: Structure, cardinalities, semantic data types and supplementary components follow EN 16931-1:2026, Table 2 of clause 6.3 and clause 6.5; the order member is the 1-based position in Table 2, and reqIds carries the identifiers of that table's requirement column. maxDecimals and maxDecimalsRule follow Table 28 in 6.5.13: the edition fixes a constant for percentages, for the invoiced quantity, for the price base quantity and for the exchange rate, and ties every amount to the ISO 4217 minor unit of its currency, which maxDecimalsRule names instead of a number. Each codeList and schemeList assignment rests on the usage note of the term's own Table 2 row; no validation artefacts exist for this edition, so no rule identifier is cited and no assignment of the 2017 registry that rested on one was carried forward. Slugs are an ESJ convention for code generation and carry no normative weight; a term that exists in both editions keeps the stem of the 2017 registry.

terms.name: Invoice number
terms.description: Unique identification of the invoice in the seller's systems; no identification scheme is used.

terms.name: Invoice issue date
terms.description: Date on which the invoice was issued.

terms.name: Invoice issue time
terms.description: Time of day at which the invoice was issued.

terms.name: Invoice type code
terms.description: Code for the functional type of the invoice, taken from UNTDID 1001.
notes: Code list UNTDID 1001. Justification: the usage note of EN 16931-1:2026 Table 2 for BT-3 names it. This edition has no validation artefacts, so no rule identifier is cited; membership of a code list is a business rule and is not checked by the structural layers.

terms.name: Invoice currency code
terms.description: The currency of every amount in this invoice; BT-111 is the one amount written in the accounting currency instead.
notes: Code list ISO 4217 alpha-3. Justification: the usage note of EN 16931-1:2026 Table 2 for BT-5 names it. This edition has no validation artefacts, so no rule identifier is cited; membership of a code list is a business rule and is not checked by the structural layers.

terms.name: VAT accounting currency exchange rate
terms.description: Value of one unit of the VAT accounting currency expressed in the invoice currency.
notes: EN 16931-1:2026, 6.5.13, Table 28 allows at most 6 fraction digits for this term.

Table 2 of the edition types this exchange rate as an Amount and Table 28 bounds it at six fraction digits, which is the minor unit of no currency. The registry records what the table says; ESJ checks no decimal bound in L1, L2 or L3, so nothing downstream depends on the oddity.

terms.name: EARLY PAYMENT DISCOUNT
terms.description: Group describing a discount granted for payment before the due date.

terms.name: Discount end date
terms.description: Last date on which the early payment discount can be claimed.

terms.name: Discount percentage
terms.description: Percentage of the invoice total with VAT granted as an early payment discount.
notes: EN 16931-1:2026, 6.5.13, Table 28 allows at most 2 fraction digits for this term.

terms.name: Discount amount
terms.description: Sum, VAT included, taken off what the buyer owes when the early payment discount applies.
notes: EN 16931-1:2026, 6.5.13, Table 28 ties the number of fraction digits of this term to the ISO 4217 minor unit of the currency it is written in, so the limit is a fact of the document rather than a constant of the term.
